title: Site-of-Service Differential Repricing
purpose: Govern claims where the billed site of service differs from the appropriate site, requiring repricing to the correct-site fee-schedule rate.
decision_rule: Determine the appropriate site of service; reprice the line to the correct-site (facility vs non-facility) fee-schedule allowance and partial-pay at that amount.
steps: Query the Fee Schedule for the facility and non-facility rate for the CPT
Determine the appropriate site of service for the procedure
Reprice the line to the correct-site allowed amount
Partial-pay at the repriced amount (CO-45 contractual adjustment)
references: CMS Physician Fee Schedule — facility vs non-facility RVUs
